slice: W209: normalized paired Dynamic Bulk/Object value composition

claim.scope: Explicit ordinary Dynamic JSON actuals reuse the existing Object child-site serde in normalized BinaryDynamicBulk streams, within the executed finite profiles; no physical/public Dynamic(JSON) storage admission.
claim.adversary_verdict: ROBUST for normalized paired ownership, P/Q/R and shared budget/depth/admission boundaries within the final executed finite corpus. Full checkpoint B remains IN_PROGRESS.
claim.overall_goal: IN_PROGRESS: checkpoint B physical/public integration, remaining type/layout contracts and MV/projections remain open; performance is deferred.
claim.review_limitation: Luna implementation and reviews are same-lineage correlated candidates. Root independently inspected the P/Q/R literals and owner/depth/budget/admission boundaries and executes all guarded workloads and final defect seeds.

implementation.root_cause: Leaf serde is reusable, but Dynamic arm identity, Object path/actual rosters and physical-parent/site/selected-child occurrence schedules are not interchangeable. A JSON ordinary-arm stop needs explicit contextual Object ownership rather than a second Cartesian-product serializer.
implementation.architecture: BinaryDynamicBulkJsonObjectWriter and BinaryDynamicBulkJsonObjectReader each have their own source file. The ordinary BinaryBulk traversal collects/injects JSON rows through the W208 adapter; ObjectDocumentCodec remains the sole Object child serde. Binding and child stream maps are separate from ordinary BinaryBulk roles.

tested_source_identity.encoding: SHA256(JSON.pretty_generate(sorted [path,size,SHA256] rows)+newline) for all src/spec files

invariants: Optional explicit bindings exactly cover every direct JSON actual at every contextual Dynamic site, including unused arms; missing, duplicate, extra, wrong-site, wrapped and SharedVariant bindings reject.
Each helper must share the exact BinaryDynamicBulkPlan and BinaryCodecBudget identity of its lower owner; recursive children inherit operation depth.
Object child occurrence grids are (P,R), not (Q,R); normalized discriminator lanes have one byte per Q occurrence.
Read all normalized discriminator lanes at all marks before Object child decode; then decode all children and all parent marks before returning any requested window.
The census alone does not certify enclosing Array Q. A valid JSON tag and child R hidden behind Array Q=0 reject in final parent/cursor consumption even for an empty selection.
Complete Object raw-path sets and complete Dynamic descriptor rosters define identity; metadata order and statistics hints do not.
Typed Nullable NULL is retained. Existing lower-owner unbound JSON and nominal JSON-containing Bulk descriptor guards remain closed even at zero-Q/empty windows.
Unused root and typed Dynamic actual descriptors are checked at inherited JSON depth; typed actual root depth is inherited JSON depth plus Object-relative Dynamic descriptor depth.
Binding/census/cursor/slice logical records and owned key-copy work are precharged under the shared budget. This is not unique-allocation, RSS, CPU-time or lazy selected-window accounting.
Legacy 3/4-argument decode_structure_streams and the explicit 5-argument overload share one internal parser; the inherited W158 test hook is exactly restored.

literal_checks.shared_plan_sites: One immutable Object plan bound to two independent Tuple Dynamic sites retains distinct values 61 and 62.
literal_checks.tested_profile: W209 focused examples use the default single_stream String profile; inherited affected gates do not qualify W209 in other profiles.

boundaries.risk: CAUTION: library-only round trips can agree on a wrong child schedule or bypass unused-arm/schema/budget/depth admission.
boundaries.rollback: Revert only the scoped atomic local W209 commit. No push/history rewrite, dependency/runtime change or source-part mutation.
boundaries.normalized_vs_physical: Normalized Q discriminator bytes correspond to stock Variant decisions, not its raw BASIC/COMPACT framing. The normalized reader cannot be applied to raw part bytes.
boundaries.eager_read_policy: All parent and child marks are decoded before slicing, including empty selection. Full-domain work may consume the full budget; malformed Q schedules may incur bounded child work before rejection.
nonclaims: Physical persisted Dynamic(JSON) arm values, public part/column/table propagation, complete checkpoint B, library-part ATTACH or fresh CHECK/native interoperability from W209.
SharedVariant inline JSON, wrapped/composite JSON actuals, Object-typed runtime JSON or arbitrary type/layout Cartesian products.
Lazy physical reads, selected-window cost bounds, full type parity, MV/projections, repository-wide class decomposition, allocator/RSS/CPU bounds or performance parity.
boundaries.inherited_residuals: Interval/SimpleAggregate sidecar metadata, AggregateFunction(count) metadata outside JSON and broader QBitValue ownership audit remain open.
boundaries.metadata_preflight_qualification: Supplied bound plans are inherited-depth preflighted before child value decode. Serialized child metadata can first parse under its local bounded depth before additional inherited validation; no allocation-before-inherited-depth guarantee is claimed.

primary_source_anchors.finding: Selected arm counts map Q to R; BASIC/COMPACT framing is not the normalized one-byte lane representation.
Array offsets map parent occurrences to child Q; child serialization still has a zero-occurrence state path.
Wide mark third words preserve physical parent P. Object child schedule is (P,R), not (Q,R).
